thread.title: AAPL gets even closer to $1tn market cap, hits new all-time high in after-hours trading

author: Benjamin Mayo
title: AAPL gets even closer to $1tn market cap, hits new all-time high in after-hours trading
text: AAPL gets even closer to $1tn market cap, hits new all-time high in after-hours trading By Benjamin Mayo Jul 31, 2018, 5:28 pm 81 pts Apple stock is now within spitting distance of the $1 trillion market cap milestone. Although after-hours trading can be volatile, it is obvious that investors are pleased with Apple’s latest earnings report. In after-market, the stock hit $197.69 — above its all-time high of $195.96, up 3.6% on…
